instruction: When editing large files in Vim, I want to see line numbers relative to my cursor position. Search online for how to enable relative line numbering in Vim and configure it as the default for my system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for how to enable relative line numbers in Vim, then editing ~/.vimrc to add 'set relativenumber' or 'set rnu'. The evaluator checks if the .vimrc file contains the relative number setting.
